text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, just after training with
Maruzensky, it
starts to rain.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer, are you free now?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer, are you free now?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I was driving in the rain, I
thought
about how fun it could be to run
in weather like
that.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The wind must feel so different when
you can
barely see and water is
splashing all around.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
This could make for some tubular
training! It'd be
a bummer to end it
here! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it'll feel great to blaze through
the pouring
rain! ♪
choice_data_list_en: Are you going to keep going?
Are you still going to keep going?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It should feel just like a morning shower!
Well,
maybe it's closer to an evening
shower...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I've still got energy to burn. I'm only just
starting
to show my true colors!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's what I'm talking about! Time to
light this
fuse!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Haha! Even the sky seems to be happy!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's go—into a world where the wind
cuts
through even the smallest of
raindrops!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thus, our training carries on into the
pouring rain.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, phooey. It's such a great
opportunity...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But I guess that's just how it is... It's
important to
take care of your health,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If you caught a cold because of me, I
would feel
terrible.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If you caught a cold because of me, I
would feel
terrible.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, let me take you for a drive in the
rain
instead! Just the two of us! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find the rainy drive a little stressful, but

Maruzensky seems to really enjoy it.
